items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I would be accompanied by Fred Bungie and his orchestra... Fred, along with Teddy Paris, his drummer, were the musicians I had made my second tour in Germany with in 1952.

ctx.x: I went back to the Trois Maillets the 2nd of December, 1958. Lily came out of the clinic the 8th of December and as the Trois Mailletz closed on Monday, I was able to fly to get her and bring her back to Paris without missing a day at the club.

I was engaged to play a big gala the 10th of January 1959, which is St. William's day in Gstaad. After St. Moritz, Gstaad is the next most popular and best known ski resort in Switzerland. As in many cases, when I did galas in different places, I didn't know with whom I would be working until I arrived at my destination. And was I surprised when I arrived at the Palace Hotel in Gstaad and found out that I would be accompanied by Fred Bungie and his orchestra. Fred, along with Teddy Paris, his drummer, were the…

On my return to Paris I met a trumpet player named Mike Wyatt. Mike was an English subject from the British West Indies whom I had met when I arrived in Paris in December 1948. He had been living in Paris for quite a while before I arrived. He was a much younger fellow than myself and we became quite good friends.
